summary: Recommends against using the AS_SET and AS_CONFED_SET path segment types in BGP. Dropping them simplifies the design and implementation of BGP and makes the route origin clearer, which also helps work on secure routing. It is a best current practice, later replaced by RFC 9774.

eli5.summary: Routes carry a list of networks they passed through. Sometimes the list is a jumbled bag instead of an order. This says stop using the bags. It was later replaced by RFC 9774.

questions: should i use as_set in bgp
